x-card.description: Keyspaces, tables and CQL reads on Cassandra and CQL-compatible services. Changes wait for approval.

contactPoints.title: Contact points
contactPoints.description: host:port of one or more nodes; the driver finds the others. Without a port: 9042. Amazon Keyspaces listens on 9142.

localDataCenter.title: Local data center
localDataCenter.description: The data center whose nodes serve every request, as nodetool status names it; found from the contact points once the form can sign in. Amazon Keyspaces: the region, such as eu-central-1.

keyspace.title: Keyspace
keyspace.description: The keyspace of statements that name none, as Cassandra stores it: lower case unless it was created with quotes. Empty: statements name their keyspace.

keyspaces.title: Keyspaces
keyspaces.description: The keyspaces agents may use; * matches any characters, such as shop_*. Empty: every keyspace but Cassandra's own system keyspaces.

user.title: User
user.description: The role GateRook signs in as. Use one that can only read wherever agents only read: the test below shows what it may do.

password.title: Password
password.description: Empty: GateRook connects without signing in.

tls.title: Connection type
tls.description: Auto uses TLS when the nodes speak it and connects without TLS only when they don't, checked before signing in. TLS goes to every node. Without TLS, the password and the data cross the network in clear; outside dev the test warns.

tlsVerify.title: TLS verification
x-enumTitles: Verify the CA and host name
tlsVerify.description: Verifying the CA only needs the cluster's own CA certificate below.

tlsServerName.title: TLS server name
tlsServerName.description: The name every node's certificate must carry, also sent as SNI. Empty: each node's own address. Amazon Keyspaces: its endpoint's name.

caCertificate.title: CA certificate (PEM)
caCertificate.description: Only for a private CA. Empty: the system trust store.

consistency.title: Read consistency
x-enumTitles: LOCAL_ONE: one replica of the local data center answers
LOCAL_QUORUM: most replicas of the local data center answer
consistency.description: Changes always write at LOCAL_QUORUM, and lightweight transactions use LOCAL_SERIAL.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: TLS details, timeouts and connections. Policies set row limits and timeouts per environment.

allowFiltering.title: Allow ALLOW FILTERING
allowFiltering.description: Dev only: reads may end with ALLOW FILTERING, which scans partitions, possibly the whole cluster.

statementTimeoutMs.title: Statement timeout
statementTimeoutMs.description: Reads stop after this long. Empty: the environment policy's statement timeout.
